## Description

Employs brain-inspired Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) with Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons to process asynchronous, event-stream limit order book tick messages with ultra-low power and latency.

## Where it may fit

Ultra-low-latency tick-by-tick order book imbalance detection, sub-millisecond execution desks.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading (HFT) prop firms, crypto market makers.

## Required data

Asynchronous event-stream L2/L3 order book updates (level quotes, cancels, trade prints).

## Caveats

SNN training via surrogate gradient descent can be difficult to stabilize on financial time series.
